mapper.select: select EmployeeID, AdminPostLevel, MainAdminPost, TeacherCertNumber, SubjectCategory, ResearchDirection, IsDoubleQualified, IsTeachingUndergrad, CounselorCategory from Staff_University_Detail where EmployeeID = #{employeeId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into Staff_University_Detail (EmployeeID, AdminPostLevel, MainAdminPost, TeacherCertNumber, SubjectCategory, ResearchDirection, IsDoubleQualified, IsTeachingUndergrad, CounselorCategory) values (#{employeeId}, #{adminPostLevel}, #{mainAdminPost}, #{teacherCertNumber}, #{subjectCategory}, #{researchDirection}, #{isDoubleQualified}, #{isTeachingUndergrad}, #{counselorCategory})
